newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's PMDB to back re-election in panel vote.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's PMDB to back re-election in panel vote.

text.p: The Brazilian Democratic Movement Party (PMDB) will vote in favor of a bill allowing President Fernando Henrique Cardoso the chance of a second term when it is put to a panel vote on Wednesday, officials said.
Six deputies from the PMDB decided they would ignore a party convention recommendation not to vote on re-election until February 15, said a spokesman for lower house leader Dep. Michel Temer.
"They will vote and they will vote in favor," the spokesman said.

Confusion as to the PMDB's position on re-election after Sunday's convention forced the government to abandon a vote scheduled for Tuesday by the lower house committee on a constitutional amendment allowing re-election.

But after a meeting with Temer, the leader of the PMDB's pro-government wing and hearing his guarantees that they would not be punished for ignoring the recommendation, the six lawmakers agreed to take part in the vote, the spokesman said.

He said no decision had been taken as to the PMDB's participation in voting on re-election on the floor of the Chamber of Deputies, which would be the next step for the amendment if approved by the committee.
